newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord Cos says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord Cos says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Gaylord Cos Inc said Wednesday it has begun preliminary discussions to acquire a company that owns real estate property in southern California.
The acquisition would be in exchange for an undetermined amount of restricted shares of Gaylord common stock.

The company said it anticipates the property would be refinanced, the proceeds of which would be used for working capital and to expand its chain of kitchenware specialty stores called The Cookstore. It did not name the company with which it was in talks.
A portion of the proceeds also would be used by the acquired corporation, which would be operated as a wholly owned subsidiary, Gaylord said.
